# Primary Model #1

Each model is evaluated at two probability cutoffs. The default is 0.5, so anyone with more than a 50% predicted probability of PANDAS is called PANDAS. The 0.85 cutoff is the stricter one for confirmation, where only people with more than an 85% probability get called PANDAS and everyone else is called HC. It trades sensitivity for fewer false positives.

Confusion matrices are laid out like this:

```
            Actual
Predicted   PANDAS   HC
PANDAS      AA       BB     <- Above the cutoff (>50% or >85% probability of PANDAS)
HC          CC       DD     <- Everyone else
```

# 1. Classification Tree -- No Covariates

Cross-Fold Validation

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Classification Tree -- No Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)
protein_columns <- setdiff(colnames(PrimaryModelOne)[which(colnames(PrimaryModelOne) == "X4E.BP1"):which(colnames(PrimaryModelOne) == "VEGFA")], c("CCL23", "CXCL5"))

tree_data <- PrimaryModelOne[, c("Diagnosis", protein_columns)]
tree_data$Diagnosis <- factor(tree_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

class_counts <- table(tree_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)
sample_weights <- class_weights[tree_data$Diagnosis]

td <- tree_data
colnames(td) <- make.names(colnames(td), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== DECISION TREE: PANDAS vs HC ==========\n\n")

cat("--- Tuning cp via One Standard Error Rule ---\n\n")

# This is the line that sets up cross fold validation
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 50,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

cp_grid <- expand.grid(cp = seq(0, 0.10, by = 0.005))

# Tree is run here ctrl used for cross fold validation
tree_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
                 data = td,
                 method = "rpart",
                 trControl = ctrl,
                 metric = "ROC",
                 tuneGrid = cp_grid,
                 weights = sample_weights)

results <- tree_cv$results
best_roc <- max(results$ROC)
best_row <- which.max(results$ROC)
se_at_best <- results$ROCSD[best_row] / sqrt(50)
threshold_1se <- best_roc - se_at_best

eligible <- results[results$ROC >= threshold_1se, ]
selected_cp <- max(eligible$cp)

cat("Best ROC:", round(best_roc, 4), "\n")
cat("Threshold (best - 1 SE):", round(threshold_1se, 4), "\n")
cat("Selected cp (simplest within 1 SE):", selected_cp, "\n")
cat("ROC at selected cp:", round(results$ROC[results$cp == selected_cp], 4), "\n\n")

cat("--- Final Tree (cp =", selected_cp, ") ---\n\n")

tree_model <- rpart(Diagnosis ~ ., data = tree_data, method = "class",
                    control = rpart.control(cp = selected_cp),
                    weights = sample_weights)

rpart.plot(tree_model, type = 3, extra = 1, under = TRUE, cex = 0.6,
           main = paste("Decision Tree (cp =", selected_cp, ")"))

cat("Variables used in tree:\n")
print(tree_model$variable.importance)

cat("\n--- Training Set Performance ---\n\n")

predictions <- predict(tree_model, tree_data, type = "class")
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predictions, tree_data$Diagnosis, positive = "PANDAS")
print(conf_matrix)

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

oof <- tree_cv$pred
oof_best <- oof[oof$cp == selected_cp, ]

roc_cv <- roc(response = oof_best$obs, predictor = oof_best$PANDAS, levels = c("HC", "PANDAS"))
roc_fig_tree <- roc_cv
plot(roc_cv, main = paste("Repeated CV ROC: PANDAS vs HC (cp =", selected_cp, ")"))
auc_cv <- auc(roc_cv)
auc_sd <- results$ROCSD[results$cp == selected_cp]

pred_05_cv <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_085_cv <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")

pred_05_cv <- factor(pred_05_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_085_cv <- factor(pred_085_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
actual <- factor(oof_best$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

cm_05_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_05_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_085_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_085_cv, Actual = actual)

acc_05_cv <- sum(diag(cm_05_cv)) / sum(cm_05_cv)
acc_085_cv <- sum(diag(cm_085_cv)) / sum(cm_085_cv)

sens_05 <- cm_05_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_05 <- cm_05_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "HC"])
sens_085 <- cm_085_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_085 <- cm_085_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "HC"])

cat("--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
cat("Balanced threshold for general classification\n")
print(cm_05_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_05_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
cat("Conservative threshold requiring strong evidence for PANDAS classification\n")
print(cm_085_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_085_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("The weighted decision tree achieved an AUC of", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "±", round(auc_sd, 3), 
    "in 10-fold cross-validation (50 repeats).\n")
cat("At a 0.5 threshold optimized for screening, the model achieved", round(sens_05 * 100, 1), 
    "% sensitivity and", round(spec_05 * 100, 1), "% specificity for detecting PANDAS cases.\n")
cat("At a 0.85 threshold optimized for confirmation, the model achieved", round(sens_085 * 100, 1),
    "% sensitivity and", round(spec_085 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("Final model uses cp =", selected_cp, "(selected via one standard error rule).\n")
```

# 3. Random Forest -- No Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Random Forest -- No Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

protein_columns <- names(PrimaryModelOne)[which(names(PrimaryModelOne) == "4E-BP1"):which(names(PrimaryModelOne) == "VEGFA")]
protein_columns <- setdiff(protein_columns, c("CCL23", "CXCL5"))

binary_raw <- PrimaryModelOne %>%
  dplyr::select(`Unique Sample ID`, Visit, Diagnosis, `Age at First Sample`) %>%
  left_join(NPX_raw %>% dplyr::select(-QC_Warning), by = c("Unique Sample ID", "Visit"))

df_raw <- binary_raw[, c("Diagnosis", "Age at First Sample", protein_columns)]
df_raw$Diagnosis <- factor(df_raw$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
colnames(df_raw) <- make.names(colnames(df_raw))
protein_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df_raw), c("Diagnosis", "Age.at.First.Sample"))

yj_all <- preProcess(df_raw[, protein_cols], method = "YeoJohnson")
yj_all_data <- as.matrix(predict(yj_all, df_raw[, protein_cols]))
age_all <- df_raw$Age.at.First.Sample
resid_all <- yj_all_data - cbind(1, age_all) %*% coef(lm(yj_all_data ~ age_all))

df <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df_raw$Diagnosis, resid_all)

binary_prep <- as.data.frame(binary_raw[, c("Unique Sample ID", "Diagnosis")])
binary_prep[, protein_columns] <- as.data.frame(resid_all)

# Custom caret model so the YJ transform and age residuals are refit inside each training fold
rf_infold <- getModelInfo("rf", regex = FALSE)[[1]]

rf_infold$fit <- function(x, y, wts, param, lev, last, classProbs, ...) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  age <- x$Age.at.First.Sample
  prot <- x[, colnames(x) != "Age.at.First.Sample", drop = FALSE]
  yj <- preProcess(prot, method = "YeoJohnson")
  prot_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, prot))
  age_coef <- coef(lm(prot_yj ~ age))
  prot_resid <- prot_yj - cbind(1, age) %*% age_coef
  model <- randomForest(x = prot_resid, y = y, mtry = min(param$mtry, ncol(prot_resid)), ...)
  model$yj <- yj
  model$age_coef <- age_coef
  model
}

rf_infold$predict <- function(modelFit, newdata, submodels = NULL) {
  newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  age <- newdata$Age.at.First.Sample
  prot <- newdata[, colnames(newdata) != "Age.at.First.Sample", drop = FALSE]
  prot_resid <- as.matrix(predict(modelFit$yj, prot)) - cbind(1, age) %*% modelFit$age_coef
  predict(modelFit, prot_resid)
}

rf_infold$prob <- function(modelFit, newdata, submodels = NULL) {
  newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  age <- newdata$Age.at.First.Sample
  prot <- newdata[, colnames(newdata) != "Age.at.First.Sample", drop = FALSE]
  prot_resid <- as.matrix(predict(modelFit$yj, prot)) - cbind(1, age) %*% modelFit$age_coef
  predict(modelFit, prot_resid, type = "prob")
}

rf_data <- df

class_counts <- table(rf_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)

rd <- df_raw

cat("========== RANDOM FOREST: PANDAS vs HC ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(rf_data), "\n")
print(table(rf_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("mtry: sqrt(p) =", round(sqrt(length(protein_columns))), "\n")
cat("ntree: 500\n\n")

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 10,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

rf_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
               data = rd,
               method = rf_infold,
               trControl = ctrl,
               metric = "ROC",
               tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = round(sqrt(length(protein_columns)))),
               ntree = 500,
               classwt = class_weights)

print(rf_cv)

cat("\n--- Final Random Forest ---\n\n")

colnames(rf_data) <- make.names(colnames(rf_data), unique = TRUE)

rf_model <- randomForest(Diagnosis ~ .,
                         data = rf_data,
                         ntree = 500,
                         mtry = round(sqrt(length(protein_columns))),
                         importance = TRUE,
                         classwt = class_weights)
print(rf_model)

cat("\n--- OOB Error Curve ---\n\n")
plot(rf_model, main = "OOB Error Rate by Number of Trees")
legend("topright", colnames(rf_model$err.rate), col = 1:3, lty = 1:3)

varImpPlot(rf_model, main = "Variable Importance - Random Forest")

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

oof <- rf_cv$pred

roc_cv <- roc(response = oof$obs, predictor = oof$PANDAS, levels = c("HC", "PANDAS"))
roc_fig_rf <- roc_cv

plot(roc_cv, main = "Repeated CV ROC: PANDAS vs HC")
auc_cv <- auc(roc_cv)
auc_sd <- sd(rf_cv$resample$ROC)

cat("Out-of-fold AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3), ")\n\n")

optimal_coords <- coords(roc_cv, "best", best.method = "youden")
optimal_threshold <- optimal_coords$threshold
optimal_sens <- optimal_coords$sensitivity
optimal_spec <- optimal_coords$specificity

cat("--- Youden's Index ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05_cv <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_opt_cv <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= optimal_threshold, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_085_cv <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")

pred_05_cv <- factor(pred_05_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_opt_cv <- factor(pred_opt_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_085_cv <- factor(pred_085_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
actual <- factor(oof$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

cm_05_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_05_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_opt_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_opt_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_085_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_085_cv, Actual = actual)

acc_05_cv <- sum(diag(cm_05_cv)) / sum(cm_05_cv)
acc_opt_cv <- sum(diag(cm_opt_cv)) / sum(cm_opt_cv)
acc_085_cv <- sum(diag(cm_085_cv)) / sum(cm_085_cv)

sens_05 <- cm_05_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_05 <- cm_05_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "HC"])
sens_085 <- cm_085_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_085 <- cm_085_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "HC"])

cat("--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
cat("Default threshold\n")
print(cm_05_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_05_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold =", round(optimal_threshold, 3), ") ---\n")
cat("Optimal threshold via Youden's index (maximizes sensitivity + specificity)\n")
print(cm_opt_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_opt_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
cat("Conservative threshold requiring strong evidence for PANDAS classification\n")
print(cm_085_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_085_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("The weighted random forest achieved an AUC of", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3),
    ") in 10-fold cross-validation (10 repeats).\n")
cat("At the optimal threshold of", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "(Youden's index), the model achieved",
    round(optimal_sens * 100, 1), "% sensitivity and", round(optimal_spec * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("At a 0.85 threshold for confirmation, the model achieved", round(sens_085 * 100, 1),
    "% sensitivity and", round(spec_085 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
```

## 3.1 Feature Selection:

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 Feature Selection
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

cat("\n========== NESTED CROSS-VALIDATION FOR FEATURE SELECTION ==========\n\n")

outer_folds <- createFolds(df_raw$Diagnosis, k = 10, returnTrain = FALSE)

outer_predictions <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:10) {

  cat("Outer fold", i, "of 10\n")

  test_idx <- outer_folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(df_raw), test_idx)

  yj <- preProcess(df_raw[train_idx, protein_cols], method = "YeoJohnson")
  train_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, df_raw[train_idx, protein_cols]))
  test_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, df_raw[test_idx, protein_cols]))

  age_train <- df_raw$Age.at.First.Sample[train_idx]
  age_test <- df_raw$Age.at.First.Sample[test_idx]
  age_fit <- lm(train_yj ~ age_train)
  train_resid <- train_yj - cbind(1, age_train) %*% coef(age_fit)
  test_resid <- test_yj - cbind(1, age_test) %*% coef(age_fit)

  train_data <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df_raw$Diagnosis[train_idx], train_resid)
  test_data <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df_raw$Diagnosis[test_idx], test_resid)

  class_weights_inner <- c("PANDAS" = 1, "HC" = sum(train_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS") / sum(train_data$Diagnosis == "HC"))

  rf_full <- randomForest(
    Diagnosis ~ .,
    data = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = floor(sqrt(length(protein_cols))),
    classwt = class_weights_inner
  )

  importance_inner <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(importance(rf_full)),
    Importance = importance(rf_full)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))

  ctrl_inner <- trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 10,
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final"
  )

  k_grid <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
  k_perf <- data.frame()

  for (k in k_grid) {
    top_k <- importance_inner$Feature[1:k]
    train_k <- train_data[, c("Diagnosis", top_k)]

    rf_k <- caret::train(
      Diagnosis ~ .,
      data = train_k,
      method = "rf",
      trControl = ctrl_inner,
      metric = "ROC",
      tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = floor(sqrt(k))),
      ntree = 500,
      classwt = class_weights_inner
    )

    k_perf <- rbind(k_perf, data.frame(k = k, ROC = mean(rf_k$resample$ROC), SD = sd(rf_k$resample$ROC)))
  }

  best_k <- k_perf$k[which.max(k_perf$ROC)]
  best_ROC <- max(k_perf$ROC)
  best_SD <- k_perf$SD[which.max(k_perf$ROC)]
  threshold_ROC <- best_ROC - best_SD
  eligible_k <- k_perf$k[k_perf$ROC >= threshold_ROC]
  chosen_k <- min(eligible_k)

  cat("  Chosen k =", chosen_k, "\n")

  selected_features <- importance_inner$Feature[1:chosen_k]

  train_final <- train_data[, c("Diagnosis", selected_features)]
  test_final <- test_data[, c("Diagnosis", selected_features)]

  rf_final <- randomForest(
    Diagnosis ~ .,
    data = train_final,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = floor(sqrt(chosen_k)),
    classwt = class_weights_inner
  )

  test_probs <- predict(rf_final, test_final, type = "prob")

  fold_preds <- data.frame(
    obs = test_data$Diagnosis,
    PANDAS = test_probs[, "PANDAS"],
    HC = test_probs[, "HC"],
    pred = predict(rf_final, test_final),
    outer_fold = i,
    chosen_k = chosen_k
  )

  outer_predictions <- rbind(outer_predictions, fold_preds)
}

cat("\n========== NESTED CV RESULTS ==========\n\n")

roc_nested <- roc(response = outer_predictions$obs, predictor = outer_predictions$PANDAS, levels = c("HC", "PANDAS"))
auc_nested <- as.numeric(auc(roc_nested))

cat("Nested CV AUC:", round(auc_nested, 3), "\n\n")

cat("Features selected per fold:\n")
print(table(outer_predictions$chosen_k))

coords_nested <- coords(roc_nested, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
youden_thresh <- coords_nested$threshold

cat("\nOptimal threshold (Youden):", round(youden_thresh, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(coords_nested$sensitivity, 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(coords_nested$specificity, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
outer_predictions$pred_0.5 <- ifelse(outer_predictions$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
outer_predictions$pred_0.5 <- factor(outer_predictions$pred_0.5, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
print(table(Predicted = outer_predictions$pred_0.5, Actual = outer_predictions$obs))
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_0.5 == "PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_0.5 == "HC" & outer_predictions$obs == "HC") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "HC"), 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold =", round(youden_thresh, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
outer_predictions$pred_youden <- ifelse(outer_predictions$PANDAS >= youden_thresh, "PANDAS", "HC")
outer_predictions$pred_youden <- factor(outer_predictions$pred_youden, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
print(table(Predicted = outer_predictions$pred_youden, Actual = outer_predictions$obs))
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_youden == "PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_youden == "HC" & outer_predictions$obs == "HC") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "HC"), 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
outer_predictions$pred_0.85 <- ifelse(outer_predictions$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")
outer_predictions$pred_0.85 <- factor(outer_predictions$pred_0.85, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
print(table(Predicted = outer_predictions$pred_0.85, Actual = outer_predictions$obs))
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_0.85 == "PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_0.85 == "HC" & outer_predictions$obs == "HC") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "HC"), 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
roc_nested <- roc(response = outer_predictions$obs, predictor = outer_predictions$PANDAS, levels = c("HC", "PANDAS"))

plot(roc_nested, main = paste0("Nested CV ROC Curve (AUC = ", round(auc(roc_nested), 2), ")"), col = "darkblue", lwd = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")

cat("\n--- Binary Feature Selection Stability (10 repeats x 10 folds) ---\n\n")

feature_tracker <- list()

set.seed(2025)

for (r in 1:10) {

  outer_folds_r <- createFolds(df_raw$Diagnosis, k = 10, returnTrain = FALSE)

  for (i in 1:10) {

    test_idx <- outer_folds_r[[i]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(df_raw), test_idx)

    yj <- preProcess(df_raw[train_idx, protein_cols], method = "YeoJohnson")
    train_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, df_raw[train_idx, protein_cols]))

    age_train <- df_raw$Age.at.First.Sample[train_idx]
    age_fit <- lm(train_yj ~ age_train)
    train_resid <- train_yj - cbind(1, age_train) %*% coef(age_fit)

    train_data <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df_raw$Diagnosis[train_idx], train_resid)

    class_weights_inner <- c("PANDAS" = 1, "HC" = sum(train_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS") / sum(train_data$Diagnosis == "HC"))

    rf_full <- randomForest(
      Diagnosis ~ .,
      data = train_data,
      ntree = 500,
      mtry = floor(sqrt(length(protein_cols))),
      classwt = class_weights_inner
    )

    importance_inner <- data.frame(
      Feature = rownames(importance(rf_full)),
      Importance = importance(rf_full)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))

    feature_tracker[[length(feature_tracker) + 1]] <- importance_inner$Feature[1:5]
  }
}

all_selected <- unlist(feature_tracker)
feature_counts <- sort(table(all_selected), decreasing = TRUE)

cat("Percent of 100 training folds with protein in top 5:\n")
print(feature_counts)

cat("\nProteins in top 5 in at least 60% of folds:\n")
print(names(feature_counts)[feature_counts >= 60])
```

## 3.6.1 Final model with selected proteins

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.6.1 Final model with selected proteins
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

# The 3 proteins that were in the top 5 in at least 60% of folds
top3_features <- c("X4E.BP1", "IL8", "TNFSF14")
rf3 <- df_raw[, c("Diagnosis", "Age.at.First.Sample", top3_features)]

ctrl_50 <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                        number = 10,
                        repeats = 50,
                        classProbs = TRUE,
                        summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                        savePredictions = "all")

rf_cv3 <- caret::train(
  Diagnosis ~ .,
  data = rf3,
  method = rf_infold,
  trControl = ctrl_50,
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = round(sqrt(3))),
  ntree = 1000,
  classwt = class_weights
)

cat("\n===== FINAL RF MODEL WITH TOP 3 FEATURES (50x10 CV, 1000 trees) =====\n")
print(rf_cv3)

oof3 <- rf_cv3$pred

roc3 <- roc(
  response = oof3$obs,
  predictor = oof3$PANDAS,
  levels = c("HC", "PANDAS")
)

plot(roc3, main = "ROC Curve: Top 3 Proteins (50x10 CV)")

auc3 <- auc(roc3)
auc3_sd <- sd(rf_cv3$resample$ROC)

cat("\nCross-Validated AUC (Top 3):", round(as.numeric(auc3), 3),
    "(SD:", round(auc3_sd, 3), ")\n")

coords3 <- coords(roc3, "best", best.method = "youden")
thresh3 <- coords3$threshold
sens3 <- coords3$sensitivity
spec3 <- coords3$specificity

cat("\nOptimal threshold (Youden):", round(thresh3, 3),
    "| Sens:", round(sens3, 3),
    "| Spec:", round(spec3, 3), "\n")

pred_05_3 <- ifelse(oof3$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_opt3 <- ifelse(oof3$PANDAS >= thresh3, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_085_3 <- ifelse(oof3$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")

pred_05_3 <- factor(pred_05_3, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_opt3 <- factor(pred_opt3, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_085_3 <- factor(pred_085_3, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

actual3 <- factor(oof3$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

cm_05_3 <- table(Predicted = pred_05_3, Actual = actual3)
cm_opt3 <- table(Predicted = pred_opt3, Actual = actual3)
cm_085_3 <- table(Predicted = pred_085_3, Actual = actual3)

sens_05 <- cm_05_3["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05_3[, "PANDAS"])
spec_05 <- cm_05_3["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_05_3[, "HC"])

sens_085 <- cm_085_3["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_085_3[, "PANDAS"])
spec_085 <- cm_085_3["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_085_3[, "HC"])

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
print(cm_05_3)
cat("Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_05_3)) / sum(cm_05_3), 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold =", round(thresh3, 3), ") ---\n")
print(cm_opt3)
cat("Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_opt3)) / sum(cm_opt3), 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens3, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec3, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
print(cm_085_3)
cat("Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_085_3)) / sum(cm_085_3), 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("The Random Forest with top 3 proteins achieved an AUC of", round(as.numeric(auc3), 3),
    "(SD:", round(auc3_sd, 3), ") in 10-fold cross-validation (50 repeats).\n")
cat("At the optimal threshold of", round(thresh3, 3), "(Youden's index), the model achieved",
    round(sens3 * 100, 1), "% sensitivity and", round(spec3 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")

importance_df3 <- data.frame(
  Protein = rownames(rf_cv3$finalModel$importance),
  Importance = rf_cv3$finalModel$importance[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance))

print(importance_df3)
```

```{r}
  show_rownames     = FALSE,

  metric        = "euclidean",
  verbose       = TRUE
)

  ggtitle("Supervised UMAP – Top 3 Proteins")
```

```{r}
cat("\n========== PATIENT SIMULATIONS (3-PROTEIN PANEL) ==========\n\n")

set.seed(2025)

rf3_data <- df[, c("Diagnosis", top3_features)]
rf_model3 <- rf_cv3$finalModel
protein_cols3 <- top3_features

cov_matrix3 <- cov(rf3_data[, protein_cols3])

all_probs3 <- predict(rf_model3, rf3_data, type = "prob")[, "PANDAS"]

rf3_with_probs <- rf3_data
rf3_with_probs$model_prob <- all_probs3
rf3_with_probs$original_diagnosis <- rf3_data$Diagnosis

hc_patients <- rf3_with_probs[rf3_with_probs$original_diagnosis == "HC", ]
pandas_patients <- rf3_with_probs[rf3_with_probs$original_diagnosis == "PANDAS", ]

all_probs3 <- rf_model3$votes[, "PANDAS"]

templates_aim1 <- rbind(
  hc_patients[which.min(abs(hc_patients$model_prob - quantile(hc_patients$model_prob, 0.10))), ],
  hc_patients[which.min(abs(hc_patients$model_prob - quantile(hc_patients$model_prob, 0.50))), ],
  hc_patients[which.min(abs(hc_patients$model_prob - quantile(hc_patients$model_prob, 0.90))), ],
  pandas_patients[which.min(abs(pandas_patients$model_prob - quantile(pandas_patients$model_prob, 0.10))), ],
  pandas_patients[which.min(abs(pandas_patients$model_prob - quantile(pandas_patients$model_prob, 0.50))), ],
  pandas_patients[which.min(abs(pandas_patients$model_prob - quantile(pandas_patients$model_prob, 0.90))), ]
)

patient_labels_aim1 <- c(
  "HC, low predicted probability",
  "HC, intermediate predicted probability",
  "HC, high predicted probability",
  "PANDAS, low predicted probability",
  "PANDAS, intermediate predicted probability",
  "PANDAS, high predicted probability"
)

n_perturb <- 100
stability_results_aim1 <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(templates_aim1)) {
  base <- templates_aim1[i, ]
  probs <- numeric(n_perturb)

  for (j in 1:n_perturb) {
    # Noise is 15% of the SD and keeps the correlation between proteins
    noise <- mvrnorm(1, mu = rep(0, length(protein_cols3)), Sigma = cov_matrix3 * 0.15^2)
    variant <- base[, protein_cols3]
    variant[1, ] <- as.numeric(variant) + noise
    probs[j] <- predict(rf_model3, variant, type = "prob")[, "PANDAS"]
  }

  stability_results_aim1 <- rbind(stability_results_aim1, data.frame(
    Patient = patient_labels_aim1[i],
    True_Diagnosis = as.character(base$original_diagnosis),
    Template_P_PANDAS = base$model_prob,
    Mean_P_PANDAS = mean(probs),
    SD_P_PANDAS = sd(probs),
    Cross_0.5 = sum(probs >= 0.5),
    Cross_Youden = sum(probs >= thresh3),
    Cross_0.85 = sum(probs >= 0.85)
  ))
}

print(stability_results_aim1)
```

```{r}
sim_table_aim1$Mean_P_PANDAS <- round(sim_table_aim1$Mean_P_PANDAS, 2)
sim_table_aim1$SD_P_PANDAS <- round(sim_table_aim1$SD_P_PANDAS, 2)

kable(sim_table_aim1,
      col.names = c("Patient Profile", "Mean P(PANDAS)", "SD",
                    "Screening (0.50), %",

                    "High-Specificity (0.85), %"),
      row.names = FALSE,

      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "% Crossing Threshold" = 3)) %>%
  footnote(general = "Perturbations added Gaussian noise proportional to protein variance while preserving correlation structure.")
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========== RANDOM FOREST INTERPRETABILITY ==========\n\n")

cat("--- 1. Direction of Effect (Mean Protein Levels by Diagnosis) ---\n\n")

top3_proteins <- top3_features

direction_df <- data.frame(Protein = top3_proteins)

direction_df$Mean_PANDAS <- sapply(top3_proteins, function(p) mean(rf3_data[[p]][rf3_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS"]))
direction_df$Mean_HC <- sapply(top3_proteins, function(p) mean(rf3_data[[p]][rf3_data$Diagnosis == "HC"]))
direction_df$SD_PANDAS <- sapply(top3_proteins, function(p) sd(rf3_data[[p]][rf3_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS"]))
direction_df$SD_HC <- sapply(top3_proteins, function(p) sd(rf3_data[[p]][rf3_data$Diagnosis == "HC"]))

direction_df$Difference <- direction_df$Mean_PANDAS - direction_df$Mean_HC
direction_df$Direction <- ifelse(direction_df$Difference > 0, "Higher in PANDAS", "Lower in PANDAS")
direction_df$Effect_Size <- direction_df$Difference / sqrt((direction_df$SD_PANDAS^2 + direction_df$SD_HC^2) / 2)

direction_df <- merge(importance_df3, direction_df, by = "Protein")
direction_df <- direction_df[order(-direction_df$Importance), ]

cat("Top 3 Proteins - Direction and Effect Size:\n\n")
print(direction_df[, c("Protein", "Importance", "Mean_PANDAS", "Mean_HC", "Direction", "Effect_Size")])
```

# 4. Random Forest -- With Covariates
Demographics don't help

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Random Forest -- With Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025) # For reproducibility

rf_data <- PrimaryModelOne[, c("Diagnosis", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Sex", protein_columns)]
rf_data$Diagnosis <- as.factor(rf_data$Diagnosis)
rf_data <- na.omit(rf_data)
names(rf_data) <- make.names(names(rf_data))

train_index <- createDataPartition(rf_data$Diagnosis, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- rf_data[train_index, ]
test_data <- rf_data[-train_index, ]

class_counts <- table(train_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)

rf_model <- randomForest(Diagnosis ~ ., 
                         data = train_data, 
                         ntree = 1000, 
                         mtry = sqrt(ncol(train_data) - 1), 
                         importance = TRUE, 
                         classwt = class_weights)

print(rf_model)

rf_predictions <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "class")
rf_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(rf_predictions, test_data$Diagnosis)
print(rf_conf_matrix)

rf_pred_probs <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")
rf_roc_curve <- multiclass.roc(test_data$Diagnosis, rf_pred_probs)
rf_auc_values <- auc(rf_roc_curve)

print(rf_auc_values)

varImpPlot(rf_model, main = "Variable Importance - Weighted Random Forest")

conf_matrix_table <- as.table(rf_conf_matrix$table)

calculate_mcc <- function(confusion_matrix) {
  n <- sum(confusion_matrix)
  sum_row <- rowSums(confusion_matrix)
  sum_col <- colSums(confusion_matrix)
  
  numerator <- 0
  for (i in 1:nrow(confusion_matrix)) {
    for (j in 1:nrow(confusion_matrix)) {
      for (k in 1:nrow(confusion_matrix)) {
        numerator <- numerator + 
          (confusion_matrix[i, i] * confusion_matrix[j, k] - 
           confusion_matrix[i, j] * confusion_matrix[k, i])
      }
    }
  }
  
  denominator <- sqrt(
    (n^2 - sum(sum_row^2)) * 
    (n^2 - sum(sum_col^2))
  )
  
  if (denominator == 0) return(0)
  return(numerator / denominator)
}

mcc <- calculate_mcc(conf_matrix_table)
print(paste("MCC:", mcc))

# Extract confusion matrix table
cm_table <- rf_conf_matrix$table

# True Positive (TP), False Positive (FP), False Negative (FN)
tp <- cm_table[positive_class, positive_class]
fp <- sum(cm_table[, positive_class]) - tp
fn <- sum(cm_table[positive_class, ]) - tp

# Precision and Recall
precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
recall <- tp / (tp + fn)

# F1 Score
f1_score <- 2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall)

cat("Precision:", round(precision, 3), "\n")
cat("Recall:", round(recall, 3), "\n")
cat("F1 Score:", round(f1_score, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.1 ROC curve and confusion matrices
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
protein_columns <- setdiff(colnames(PrimaryModelOne)[which(colnames(PrimaryModelOne) == "X4E.BP1"):which(colnames(PrimaryModelOne) == "VEGFA")], c("CCL23", "CXCL5"))

rf_data <- PrimaryModelOne[, c("Diagnosis", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Sex", protein_columns)]
rf_data$Diagnosis <- factor(rf_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
rf_data <- rf_data[complete.cases(rf_data), ]
names(rf_data) <- make.names(names(rf_data))

class_counts <- table(rf_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)

rd <- rf_data
colnames(rd) <- make.names(colnames(rd), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== RANDOM FOREST WITH DEMOGRAPHICS: PANDAS vs HC ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(rf_data), "\n")
print(table(rf_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

n_predictors <- ncol(rf_data) - 1

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("mtry: sqrt(p) =", round(sqrt(n_predictors)), "\n")
cat("ntree: 500\n\n")

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 10,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

rf_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
               data = rd,
               method = "rf",
               trControl = ctrl,
               metric = "ROC",
               tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = round(sqrt(n_predictors))),
               ntree = 500,
               classwt = class_weights)

print(rf_cv)

cat("\n--- Final Random Forest ---\n\n")

rf_model <- randomForest(Diagnosis ~ ., 
                         data = rf_data, 
                         ntree = 500, 
                         mtry = round(sqrt(n_predictors)), 
                         importance = TRUE, 
                         classwt = class_weights)

print(rf_model)

cat("\n--- OOB Error Curve ---\n\n")
plot(rf_model, main = "OOB Error Rate by Number of Trees (with Demographics)")
legend("topright", colnames(rf_model$err.rate), col = 1:3, lty = 1:3)

varImpPlot(rf_model, main = "Variable Importance - Random Forest with Demographics")

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")
oof <- rf_cv$pred

roc_cv <- roc(response = oof$obs, predictor = oof$PANDAS, levels = c("HC", "PANDAS"))
roc_fig_rf_cov <- roc_cv
plot(roc_cv, main = "Repeated CV ROC: PANDAS vs HC (with Demographics)")
auc_cv <- auc(roc_cv)
auc_sd <- sd(rf_cv$resample$ROC)

cat("Out-of-fold AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3), ")\n\n")

optimal_coords <- coords(roc_cv, "best", best.method = "youden")
optimal_threshold <- optimal_coords$threshold
optimal_sens <- optimal_coords$sensitivity
optimal_spec <- optimal_coords$specificity

cat("--- Optimal Threshold (Youden's Index) ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05_cv <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_opt_cv <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= optimal_threshold, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_085_cv <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")

pred_05_cv <- factor(pred_05_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_opt_cv <- factor(pred_opt_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_085_cv <- factor(pred_085_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
actual <- factor(oof$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

cm_05_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_05_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_opt_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_opt_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_085_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_085_cv, Actual = actual)

acc_05_cv <- sum(diag(cm_05_cv)) / sum(cm_05_cv)
acc_opt_cv <- sum(diag(cm_opt_cv)) / sum(cm_opt_cv)
acc_085_cv <- sum(diag(cm_085_cv)) / sum(cm_085_cv)

spec_05 <- cm_05_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "HC"])
sens_085 <- cm_085_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_085 <- cm_085_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "HC"])

cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_05_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold =", round(optimal_threshold, 3), ") ---\n")
cat("Optimal threshold via Youden's index (maximizes sensitivity + specificity)\n")
print(cm_opt_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_opt_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
cat("Conservative threshold requiring strong evidence for PANDAS classification\n")
print(cm_085_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_085_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("The weighted random forest with demographics achieved an AUC of", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3), 
    ") in 10-fold cross-validation (10 repeats).\n")
cat("At the optimal threshold of", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "(Youden's index), the model achieved", 
    round(optimal_sens * 100, 1), "% sensitivity and", round(optimal_spec * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("At a 0.85 threshold for confirmation, the model achieved", round(sens_085 * 100, 1),
    "% sensitivity and", round(spec_085 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n")

    ") in 10-fold cross-validation (10 repeats).\n")
cat("Best tuning parameters: C =", svm_cv$bestTune$C, ", sigma =", round(svm_cv$bestTune$sigma, 4), "\n")
```

# 6. SVM -- With Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. SVM -- With Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
protein_columns <- setdiff(colnames(PrimaryModelOne)[which(colnames(PrimaryModelOne) == "X4E.BP1"):which(colnames(PrimaryModelOne) == "VEGFA")], c("CCL23", "CXCL5"))

svm_data <- PrimaryModelOne[, c("Diagnosis", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Sex", protein_columns)]
svm_data$Diagnosis <- factor(svm_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
svm_data <- svm_data[complete.cases(svm_data), ]

svm_df <- svm_data
colnames(svm_df) <- make.names(colnames(svm_df), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== SVM (RADIAL) WITH DEMOGRAPHICS: PANDAS vs HC ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(svm_data), "\n")
print(table(svm_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("Kernel: Radial basis function\n")
cat("Preprocessing: Centered and scaled\n\n")

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 10,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

svm_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
                       data = svm_df,
                       method = "svmRadial",
                       trControl = ctrl,
                       metric = "ROC",
                       preProcess = c("center", "scale"))

print(svm_cv)

cat("\n--- Final SVM Model ---\n\n")

svm_model <- svm(Diagnosis ~ ., 
                 data = sd,
                 kernel = "radial",
                 probability = TRUE,
                 scale = TRUE)

print(svm_model)

cat("\n--- Training Set Performance (Final Model) ---\n\n")

train_predictions <- predict(svm_model, sd, probability = TRUE)
train_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(train_predictions, sd$Diagnosis, positive = "PANDAS")
print(train_conf_matrix)

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

oof <- svm_cv$pred
oof_best <- oof[oof$C == svm_cv$bestTune$C & oof$sigma == svm_cv$bestTune$sigma, ]

roc_cv <- roc(response = oof_best$obs, predictor = oof_best$PANDAS, levels = c("HC", "PANDAS"))
roc_fig_svm_cov <- roc_cv
plot(roc_cv, main = "Repeated CV ROC: PANDAS vs HC (SVM Radial with Demographics)")
auc_cv <- auc(roc_cv)
auc_sd <- sd(svm_cv$resample$ROC)

cat("Out-of-fold AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3), ")\n\n")

optimal_coords <- coords(roc_cv, "best", best.method = "youden")
optimal_threshold <- optimal_coords$threshold
optimal_sens <- optimal_coords$sensitivity
optimal_spec <- optimal_coords$specificity

cat("--- Optimal Threshold (Youden's Index) ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05_cv <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_opt_cv <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= optimal_threshold, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_085_cv <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")

pred_05_cv <- factor(pred_05_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_opt_cv <- factor(pred_opt_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_085_cv <- factor(pred_085_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
actual <- factor(oof_best$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

cm_05_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_05_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_opt_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_opt_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_085_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_085_cv, Actual = actual)

acc_05_cv <- sum(diag(cm_05_cv)) / sum(cm_05_cv)
acc_opt_cv <- sum(diag(cm_opt_cv)) / sum(cm_opt_cv)
acc_085_cv <- sum(diag(cm_085_cv)) / sum(cm_085_cv)

sens_05 <- cm_05_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_05 <- cm_05_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "HC"])
sens_085 <- cm_085_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_085 <- cm_085_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "HC"])

cat("--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")

cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_05_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold =", round(optimal_threshold, 3), ") ---\n")
cat("Optimal threshold via Youden's index (maximizes sensitivity + specificity)\n")
print(cm_opt_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_opt_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
cat("Conservative threshold requiring strong evidence for PANDAS classification\n")
```

# 7. Gradient Boosting -- No Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Gradient Boosting -- No Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

protein_columns <- setdiff(colnames(PrimaryModelOne)[4:81], c("CCL23", "CXCL5"))

xgb_data <- PrimaryModelOne[, c("Diagnosis", protein_columns)]
xgb_data$Diagnosis <- factor(xgb_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

colnames(xgb_data) <- make.names(colnames(xgb_data), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== XGBOOST: PANDAS vs HC ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(xgb_data), "\n")
print(table(xgb_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

n_pandas <- sum(xgb_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS")
n_hc <- sum(xgb_data$Diagnosis == "HC")
scale_pos_weight <- n_hc / n_pandas

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("Parameters (conservative for small sample):\n")
cat("  eta = 0.1, max_depth = 3, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8\n")
cat("  scale_pos_weight =", round(scale_pos_weight, 3), "\n\n")

X <- as.matrix(xgb_data[, -1])
y <- as.numeric(xgb_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS")

params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  eta = 0.1,
  max_depth = 3,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  gamma = 0,
  scale_pos_weight = scale_pos_weight
)

oof_preds <- rep(NA, nrow(xgb_data))
auc_values <- c()

for (rep in 1:10) {
  folds <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = nrow(xgb_data)))
  
  for (fold in 1:10) {
    train_idx <- which(folds != fold)
    test_idx <- which(folds == fold)
    
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X[train_idx, ], label = y[train_idx])
    dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X[test_idx, ], label = y[test_idx])
    
    model <- xgb.train(
      params = params,
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = 100,
      verbose = 0
    )
    
    oof_preds[test_idx] <- predict(model, dtest)
  }
  
  auc_values <- c(auc_values, as.numeric(roc(y, oof_preds, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")$auc))
}

cat("--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

roc_cv <- roc(y, oof_preds, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
roc_fig_gbm <- roc_cv
plot(roc_cv, main = "Repeated CV ROC: PANDAS vs HC (XGBoost)")
auc_cv <- auc(roc_cv)
auc_sd <- sd(auc_values)

cat("Out-of-fold AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3), ")\n\n")

optimal_coords <- coords(roc_cv, "best", best.method = "youden")
optimal_threshold <- optimal_coords$threshold
optimal_sens <- optimal_coords$sensitivity
optimal_spec <- optimal_coords$specificity

cat("--- Optimal Threshold (Youden's Index) ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05_cv <- ifelse(oof_preds >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_opt_cv <- ifelse(oof_preds >= optimal_threshold, "PANDAS", "HC")
pred_085_cv <- ifelse(oof_preds >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "HC")

pred_05_cv <- factor(pred_05_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_opt_cv <- factor(pred_opt_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
pred_085_cv <- factor(pred_085_cv, levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
actual <- factor(ifelse(y == 1, "PANDAS", "HC"), levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))

cm_05_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_05_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_opt_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_opt_cv, Actual = actual)
cm_085_cv <- table(Predicted = pred_085_cv, Actual = actual)

acc_05_cv <- sum(diag(cm_05_cv)) / sum(cm_05_cv)
acc_opt_cv <- sum(diag(cm_opt_cv)) / sum(cm_opt_cv)
acc_085_cv <- sum(diag(cm_085_cv)) / sum(cm_085_cv)

sens_05 <- cm_05_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_05 <- cm_05_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_05_cv[, "HC"])
sens_085 <- cm_085_cv["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "PANDAS"])
spec_085 <- cm_085_cv["HC", "HC"] / sum(cm_085_cv[, "HC"])

cat("--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
cat("Default threshold\n")
print(cm_05_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_05_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold =", round(optimal_threshold, 3), ") ---\n")
cat("Optimal threshold via Youden's index (maximizes sensitivity + specificity)\n")
print(cm_opt_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_opt_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(optimal_sens, 3), "| Specificity:", round(optimal_spec, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
cat("Conservative threshold requiring strong evidence for PANDAS classification\n")
print(cm_085_cv)
cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_085_cv, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Final XGBoost Model ---\n\n")

dtrain_full <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X, label = y)
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_full,
  nrounds = 100,
  verbose = 0
)

cat("\n--- Training Set Performance (Final Model) ---\n\n")

train_pred_probs <- predict(xgb_model, dtrain_full)
train_pred_class <- factor(ifelse(train_pred_probs >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "HC"), levels = c("PANDAS", "HC"))
train_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(train_pred_class, xgb_data$Diagnosis, positive = "PANDAS")
print(train_conf_matrix)

cat("\n--- Feature Importance ---\n\n")

importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X), model = xgb_model)
xgb.plot.importance(importance_matrix, main = "Feature Importance - XGBoost")

importance_df <- importance_matrix %>%
  arrange(desc(Gain)) %>%
  mutate(Index = row_number())

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Index, y = Gain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Elbow Plot of Feature Importance (Gain)") +
  xlab("Feature Index") +
  ylab("Gain")

cat("\n--- Inflection Point Analysis ---\n\n")

inflection::findipiterplot(importance_df$Index, importance_df$Gain, 2)

elbow <- inflection::findiplist(importance_df$Index, importance_df$Gain, 0)
inflection_index <- elbow["ESE", "j1"]

important_features <- importance_df$Feature[1:inflection_index]
important_features_xgb <- important_features
cat("Proteins before inflection point (based on ESE):\n")
print(important_features)

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("The XGBoost model achieved an AUC of", round(as.numeric(auc_cv), 3), "(SD:", round(auc_sd, 3), 
    ") in 10-fold cross-validation (10 repeats).\n")
cat("Parameters: eta = 0.1, max_depth = 3, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8, nrounds = 100\n")
cat("At the optimal threshold of", round(optimal_threshold, 3), "(Youden's index), the model achieved", 
    round(optimal_sens * 100, 1), "% sensitivity and", round(optimal_spec * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("At a 0.85 threshold for confirmation, the model achieved", round(sens_085 * 100, 1),
    "% sensitivity and", round(spec_085 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("Top", inflection_index, "features identified by inflection analysis:", paste(important_features, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
    round(optimal_sens * 100, 1), "% sensitivity and", round(optimal_spec * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("At a 0.85 threshold for confirmation, the model achieved", round(sens_085 * 100, 1),
    "% sensitivity and", round(spec_085 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")
cat("Top", inflection_index, "features identified by inflection analysis:", paste(important_features, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
plot(roc_cv, main = "Repeated CV ROC: PANDAS vs HC (XGBoost with Demographics)")
```
